name.en: Risk Case is not ISO Risk

text.en: Case identity is preserved across descriptions, scores, owners and administrative states. Equal labels do not establish case identity. This note records an interpretation constraint; it is not an executable formal encoding.

A scenario, consequence statement, signal, plan or report alone must not create actual occurrences, outcomes, controls or effectiveness assertions. This note records an interpretation constraint; it is not an executable formal encoding.

Issued semantic content and effective dependency versions are immutable. Correction and supersession create lineage-preserving new versions. This note records an interpretation constraint; it is not an executable formal encoding.

Results retain method/scale version, dimension, basis, relevant context and time semantics. A score is not the risk, and estimated likelihood need not be numeric. This note records an interpretation constraint; it is not an executable formal encoding.

Recorded time, reference time and validity intervals are distinct. Workflow closure does not prove risk cessation or successful treatment. This note records an interpretation constraint; it is not an executable formal encoding.

An asserted ResponsibilityRelator requires at least two distinct mediated individuals. If bearer and authority resolve to one actor and no further grounding exists, retain ResponsibilityAssignmentInformation without asserting the relator. This note records an interpretation constraint; it is not an executable formal encoding.

ResponsibleAgentRole does not automatically mean Risk Owner. Ownership mapping requires recorded responsibility type, accountability, authority and applicable context. This note records an interpretation constraint; it is not an executable formal encoding.

At least one of thresholdForIndicator or thresholdOnScale is present. If both are present, their scale/unit interpretation is compatible. Qualitative boundaries use scale semantics rather than invented numeric units. This note records an interpretation constraint; it is not an executable formal encoding.

Every published RiskDescription has at least one case, pattern or scenario target. Multiple valid targets are permitted and require explicit interpretation. This note records an interpretation constraint; it is not an executable formal encoding.

Tolerance statements retain source framework/version, original meaning and context. Permissible deviation is not automatically equivalent to readiness to bear remaining risk. This note records an interpretation constraint; it is not an executable formal encoding.

Vocabulary resources retain scheme-qualified identity. Labels are representations and are not OWL classes by default. This note records an interpretation constraint; it is not an executable formal encoding.

EvidenceReference states an evidential role such as support, challenge or context. Linking a source does not automatically prove the target claim. This note records an interpretation constraint; it is not an executable formal encoding.

A selected level belongs to the selected scale version and dimension. Results on incompatible methods/scales are not ranked merely by equal labels or numeric codes. This note records an interpretation constraint; it is not an executable formal encoding.

RiskSource, Consequence and RiskControl remain catalog notions and optional external boundaries, excluded from native formal-core class assertions. Source, outcome and control content is represented by RiskSourceReference, ConsequenceStatement and ControlReference. This note records an interpretation constraint; it is not an executable formal encoding.

Every asserted intrinsic Vulnerability has exactly one substantial-endurant bearer. A reported hypothesis alone is information, not an actual mode. This note records an interpretation constraint; it is not an executable formal encoding.

Raw source content is retained in staging. Managed records require identity, subject, title and provenance. Analytical readiness additionally requires the pinned context, method, scale, basis, dimension and time required for the selected task. This note records an interpretation constraint; it is not an executable formal encoding.
